changelog: v0.2.0: Major upgrade: 1) Eliminate native Android speech recognition beeps in Live Mode, 2) Add 4-phase visual Conversational Pipeline Stepper (Listening -> Analyzing -> Ready -> Speaking) and real-time Voice Activity Level Meter, 3) High-fidelity realistic 3D human avatars (Maya & Alex with Ready Player Me glTF models & articulated skeletal rigs), 4) Modular architecture with automated regression test suite.
